description: FKM official K_f (Siebel & Stieler Stuetzahl, Eq. 2.3.2/2.3.6-2.3.8/2.3.17, Table 2.3.1/2.3.5) native-chain AFT decomposition vs Peterson approximation.

fkm_official_parameters.formula_ref: FKM 7th ed. Eq. 2.3.2/2.3.6-2.3.8; Table 2.3.1 & 2.3.5 (G_sigma = 2.3/r*(1+phi), flat-strip notch bending)

summary: FKM official K_f = 1.8676 vs Peterson K_f = 1.8426 (ratio 1.014). Native-chain standard share: Peterson 68.5% (v6.0) vs official 69.1%. The official FKM Stuetzahl procedure (Table 2.3.5 notch gradient G_sigma = 2.3/r*(1+phi), phi=0.44 at t/r=3.29, B/b=4.90) gives a K_f within 1.5% of the Peterson approximation for this gear geometry (r=1.14 mm, Rm=1000 MPa), so the v6.0 native-chain conclusions are unchanged.
